headers.name: actual_canonical_sorted_anchor_receiver
headers.header:
theorem actual_canonical_sorted_anchor_receiver
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (n mask : Nat) (rank : N.BlobPort b ≃ Fin n)
      (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ)
      (xs : List (M).OpenedTip) (k : Nat) (T : Tree),
      2≤n ∧ mask<2^n ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧ k≤1 ∧
      (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => (rank ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)).val)=occurrenceLabels n mask ∧
      T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1 ∧
      (∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ N.BlobPort b,
        (M).rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩ ∧
        (M).rawQuartetMean q=Nanuq.Quartet.distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)) ∧
      (∀ (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => N.blobProjection b hb (q i))),
        N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 0))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 1))).val,
           (rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 2))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 3))).val⟩ ∧
        N.rawQuartetMean q=Nanuq.Quartet.distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 0))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 1))).val,
           (rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 2))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 3))).val⟩)) ∧
      (∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ N.BlobPort b,
        (twiceMean (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
          (rank (q 0)).val (rank (q 1)).val (rank (q 2)).val (rank (q 3)).val : ℚ)=
          2*(M).rawQuartetMean q) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 4 → N.BlobPort b, v 2≠v 3 →
        (anchor (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
          (rank (v 2)).val (rank (v 3)).val (rank (v 0)).val (rank (v 1)).val : ℚ)=
          (M).actualTupleAnchor v)

headers.name: actual_sorted_query_mean
headers.header:
theorem actual_sorted_query_mean (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) :
    (twiceMean (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      (rank (q 0)).val (rank (q 1)).val (rank (q 2)).val (rank (q 3)).val : ℚ)=
      2*N.rawQuartetMean q

headers.name: actual_sorted_anchor
headers.header:
theorem actual_sorted_anchor (v : Fin 4 → X) (hpq : v 2≠v 3) :
    (anchor (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      (rank (v 2)).val (rank (v 3)).val (rank (v 0)).val (rank (v 1)).val : ℚ)=
      N.actualTupleAnchor v

headers.name: actual_diagonal_anchor
headers.header:
theorem actual_diagonal_anchor (v : Fin 4 → X) (hpq : v 2=v 3) :
    N.actualTupleAnchor v=0

headers.name: tuple_range_iff
headers.header:
theorem tuple_range_iff (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (z : Nat) :
    (∃ i, v i=z) ↔ z∈[v 0,v 1,v 2,v 3]

headers.name: equal_range_permutation
headers.header:
theorem equal_range_permutation (v w : Fin 4 ↪ Nat)
    (h : ∀ z, (∃ i, v i=z) ↔ ∃ j, w j=z) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4), ∀ i, v i=w (σ i)

headers.name: sorted_query_coordinates
headers.header:
theorem sorted_query_coordinates (n : Nat) (q : Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) :
    ∃ (v : Fin 4 ↪ Nat) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)),
      (∀ i, (q i).val=v (σ i)) ∧
      (quartets n)[quartetIndex (quartets n) (q 0).val (q 1).val (q 2).val (q 3).val]?=
        some (coordinateQuartet v)

headers.name: reindexResolution_bijective
headers.header:
theorem reindexResolution_bijective :
    ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4), Function.Bijective (reindexResolution σ)

headers.name: reindexResolution_sides
headers.header:
theorem reindexResolution_sides :
    ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (r : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 4),
      (indexSide r i == indexSide r j)=
        (indexSide (reindexResolution σ r) (σ i) == indexSide (reindexResolution σ r) (σ j))

headers.name: reindexResolution_cut
headers.header:
theorem reindexResolution_cut :
    ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (r : Fin 3) (L R : Fin 4 → Bool),
      indexCut r (fun i => L (σ i)) (fun i => R (σ i))=
        indexCut (reindexResolution σ r) L R

headers.name: coordinate_edgeWitness
headers.header:
theorem coordinate_edgeWitness (tips : List Nat) (lo len : Nat)
    (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 3) :
    edgeWitness tips lo len (coordinateQuartet v) r.val =
      indexCut r (fun i => ((tips.drop lo).take len).contains (v i))
        (fun i => (tips.take lo++tips.drop (lo+len)).contains (v i))

headers.name: edgeWitness_coordinate_permutation
headers.header:
theorem edgeWitness_coordinate_permutation (tips : List Nat) (lo len : Nat)
    (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (r : Fin 3) :
    edgeWitness tips lo len (coordinateQuartet (fun i => v (σ i))) r.val=
      edgeWitness tips lo len (coordinateQuartet v) (reindexResolution σ r).val

headers.name: coordinate_side
headers.header:
theorem coordinate_side (v : Fin 4 ↪ Nat) (r : Fin 3) (i : Fin 4) :
    (coordinateQuartet v).side r.val (v i)=indexSide r i

headers.name: mask_distinctMean_exact
headers.header:
theorem mask_distinctMean_exact : ∀ g : Fin 3 → Bool,
    distinctMean (({.xy_zw,.xz_yw,.xw_yz} : Finset Resolution).filter
      (fun r => g (resolutionFin r)=true))=indexedMean g

headers.name: indexedMean_permutation
headers.header:
theorem indexedMean_permutation : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (g : Fin 3 → Bool),
    indexedMean (fun r => g (reindexResolution σ r))=indexedPairMean g (σ 0) (σ 1)

headers.name: finiteWitnessMask_iff
headers.header:
theorem finiteWitnessMask_iff (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 3) :
    finiteWitnessMask T tips v r=true ↔
      ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1, edgeWitness tips e.1 e.2 (coordinateQuartet v) r.val=true

headers.name: finiteResolutionSet_mean
headers.header:
theorem finiteResolutionSet_mean (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat) :
    distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T tips (coordinateQuartet v))=
      indexedMean (finiteWitnessMask T tips v)

headers.name: finiteWitnessMask_permutation
headers.header:
theorem finiteWitnessMask_permutation (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (r : Fin 3) :
    finiteWitnessMask T tips (fun i => v (σ i)) r=
      finiteWitnessMask T tips v (reindexResolution σ r)

headers.name: finite_distinctMean_permutation
headers.header:
theorem finite_distinctMean_permutation (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T tips (coordinateQuartet (fun i => v (σ i))))=
      indexedPairMean (finiteWitnessMask T tips v) (σ 0) (σ 1)

headers.name: sorted_query_mean
headers.header:
theorem sorted_query_mean (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1) (q : Fin 4 ↪ Fin n) :
    (twiceMean (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      (q 0).val (q 1).val (q 2).val (q 3).val : ℚ)=
      2 * distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        (coordinateQuartet (fun i => (q i).val)))

headers.name: three_filter_ratio
headers.header:
theorem three_filter_ratio (g h : Nat → Bool) :
    ((((List.range 3).filter g).filter h).length : ℚ) / (((List.range 3).filter g).length : ℚ)=
      (((presentIndices (fun r => g r.val)).filter (fun r => h r.val)).length : ℚ) /
        ((presentIndices (fun r => g r.val)).length : ℚ)

headers.name: finiteWitnessMask_code
headers.header:
theorem finiteWitnessMask_code (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (qs : List Quartet)
    (idx : Nat) (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (hv : qs[idx]?=some (coordinateQuartet v)) (r : Fin 3) :
    finiteWitnessMask T tips v r=
      (code (T.summary (edgeContribution tips qs) 1) idx).testBit r.val

headers.name: indexedPairMean_code
headers.header:
theorem indexedPairMean_code (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (qs : List Quartet)
    (idx : Nat) (v : Fin 4 ↪ Nat) (hv : qs[idx]?=some (coordinateQuartet v)) (i j : Fin 4) :
    indexedPairMean (finiteWitnessMask T tips v) i j=
      ((((List.range 3).filter (fun r => (code (T.summary (edgeContribution tips qs) 1) idx).testBit r)).filter
        (fun r => (coordinateQuartet v).side r (v i) != (coordinateQuartet v).side r (v j))).length : ℚ) /
        (((List.range 3).filter (fun r => (code (T.summary (edgeContribution tips qs) 1) idx).testBit r)).length : ℚ)
